name: stuff-cheeks
flavor_text: The user eats its held Berry, then sharply boosts its Defense stat.
effect_text_extend: This move cannot be used unless the user is holding a berry. The user consumes a berry, activates its effects, and raises its defense by 2 stages. This effect works even if Embargo or Magic Room are in effect.
effect_text_simple: User consumes berry and raises its defense by 2 stages.
